# Active work — legeos

Live work, grouped by parent in `ROADMAP.md` order. Blocked work names its blocker inline.

## [M1 — The session runs: persistent policy, real containment, journalled files, recoverable windows, transactional host](ROADMAP.md#m1--the-session-runs-persistent-policy-real-containment-journalled-files-recoverable-windows-transactional-host) `@legeos.milestone.m1-session-runtime/1`

### The clients: the CLI over the whole OS, one portal backend, the Home Surface model, Settings

`proposed` · `@legeos.work.consumers-cli-portal-shell/1` · part of `@legeos.milestone.m1-session-runtime/1`

Make the services reachable: lege as one command line over identity, launching, associations with an explanation, files and operations, resources, history with undo, providers, settings, projects, power and updates; xdg-desktop-portal-lege as the single backend implementing FileChooser over the shared last-directory answer, OpenURI and AppChooser over the association broker, Settings and Background over providers and autostart, so a sandboxed application and a normal one behave the same; the Home Surface as a data model over the services (drawers, dock grouping by canonical AppId, the window shelf, the operations drawer) rendered without a toolkit for now; and lege-settings as pages that map one-to-one onto D-Bus interfaces, with nothing a private implementation detail. Everything the shell shows must be available through lege as well.

### The session daemon: one state store, StartTransientUnit launching, desktop-entry import, the full domain surface

`proposed` · `@legeos.work.sessiond-persistence-and-launch/1` · part of `@legeos.milestone.m1-session-runtime/1`

Wire lege-sessiond to the one state store so every domain survives a restart (associations, provider selections and declarations, autostart approvals, settings values and their change log, projects, history, live instances re-derived from ListUnitsByPatterns app-legeos-*); replace the systemd-run launcher with a direct StartTransientUnit D-Bus transaction so launch and unit registration are one step and the documented registration race disappears; derive manifests from installed desktop entries with Exec field codes parsed into an argument vector; detect MIME types from shared-mime-info globs and bounded content sniffing so a detected type genuinely beats an extension; and serve the remaining domains — the full Associations surface with Explain, Settings, History with Undo, Providers, Projects, Power, Location, and org.freedesktop.Notifications recorded as history events — plus the autostart runner, the checkpoint relay and coredump ingestion.
